identity.name: Khaki Field Mechanical
identity.one_liner: A hand-wound 38mm field watch built to the pattern of Hamilton's Vietnam-era military issue pieces.

provenance_events.description: Hamilton's Khaki Field Mechanical 38 (H69439931) becomes the brand's most-cited military-flavored watch — a 38mm hand-wound field watch based on the 1960s MIL-W-3818B spec, with a 50m water resistance and a nylon strap.

narrative.story: Hamilton supplied field watches to the US military for decades under the MIL-W-46374 specification, and the 2018 Khaki Field Mechanical is the closest thing to that watch in a current catalog: 38mm, matte dial, no date, and the H-50 hand-wound movement with an 80-hour reserve. Winding it every morning is the point — it teaches the mechanical habit that grail ownership assumes.
narrative.collector_notes: The lug width is 20mm and the watch was designed for straps, not a bracelet. The matte earth-tone dial variants sell out in cycles; the black-dial reference here is the constant.
